# INV-USD for 100.00 USD, posted to a USD receivable and paid in full out of a
# USD bank. The line books to a CAD income account, so posting it needs the
# rates file. What this fixture produces: the invoice settled, its lot closed.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-USD"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

invoice "INV-USD"
	customer_id: "C-USD"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 100
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
		memo: "Paid in dollars"
